summary: The customer, Khaled, called to inquire about an unexpected extra charge on his bill due to an automatic contract renewal that he had previously requested to cancel. The agent, Ahmad, verified the account, acknowledged the miscommunication in the system, and successfully cancelled the auto-renewal retroactively and removed the extra charges. The call ended cordially with the customer expressing satisfaction.

evidence.text: سأقوم حالياً بإلغاء التجديد التلقائي بأثر رجعي، وإلغاء الرسوم الإضافية عن فاتورة هذا الشهر.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Cancel the automatic renewal retroactively and remove the extra charges from this month's bill.

evidence.text: بكل سرور يا سيد خالد، حقك على راسي. سأقوم حالياً بإلغاء التجديد التلقائي بأثر رجعي
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent was extremely polite, respectful, and professional throughout the call.

evidence.text: أنا أعتذر عن هذا الإتباع غير الدقيق للملاحظة، ويبدو أنه حدث التباس في تسجيل طلبك في النظام.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent sincerely apologized for the system error and validated the customer's frustration.

evidence.text: تماماً كما تريد يا سيد خالد، تم إلغاء الرسوم وتعديل حالة العقد بنجاح.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent fully resolved the customer's issue by cancelling the renewal and removing the extra fees.

evidence.text: دعني أتحقق من تفاصيل حسابك والعقد الحالي فوراً، ممكن رقم الحساب من فضلك؟
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent spoke clearly, kept the customer informed, and explained the actions taken without ambiguity.

evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent properly checked if there was anything else needed, confirmed resolution, and delivered a professional closing.

evidence.text: أرى فعلاً أن العقد تم تجديده قبل ثلاثة أسابيع بناءً على الباقة السابقة، وتم تطبيق رسوم الشهر الجديد.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately retrieved and described the account state and the timing of the renewal.
